name: ai-front-desk-oss
description: A simple, self-hostable client dashboard for Assistable.ai AI voice agents.

paragraphs: A simple, self-hostable client dashboard built on the Assistable.ai API. Give each client a clean, branded login to see what their AI voice agent handled — calls, recordings, transcripts, sentiment, and chat volume — a lightweight, read-only view you fully control.

Built for people already using the Assistable API / CLI / MCP: point it at your API key + a subaccount, deploy it, and send each client a URL and a login. It reads Assistable through a server-side proxy, so your API key never touches the browser and each client only ever sees their own, read-only data.

Assistable is where you build and run your AI voice agents. This is a small companion for the client-facing side: when you'd rather give a client a simple, branded URL scoped to just their own numbers, drop this in front of the Assistable API. One URL, one login, read-only, self-hosted, and yours to brand.
